list.title: Page heading of the screen listing the Listmonk lists this CRM is wired to. A DIFFERENT screen from the live Listmonk list browser (plugins.listmonk.lists.title) — the two must never share a key. ≤3 words. Glossary: newsletter stays 'newsletter'.
list.columns.listmonkId: Table column header: the list's numeric id inside Listmonk. Keep the brand name and the technical 'ID'. ≤3 words.
list.columns.name: Table column header: the name this CRM shows for the list. 1 word. CSS uppercases headers, so give sentence case.
list.columns.syncedAt: Table column header: when contacts were last synced with this list. ≤2 words.
list.never: Value in that column when no sync has ever run. 1 word.
list.empty: Shown in the table body when no list has been wired up yet. ≤4 words.
list.delete.title: Title of the delete confirmation for one wired list. A question, ≤4 words. Polish uses the infinitive ('Usunąć…?'). This screen used to hand-roll its own modal — it now goes through useConfirm.
list.delete.message: Body of that confirmation. {name} is the list's display name and must be wrapped in the locale's own quote marks (Polish „…”, English “…”). Say that the action cannot be undone. Replaces a sentence that was split across three DOM nodes.
list.delete.confirm: The destructive button in that confirmation. Names the action AND the object — never a bare 'OK'. ≤3 words.
add.title: Heading of the form below the table that wires up another Listmonk list. Polish is a noun phrase, not an imperative. ≤4 words.
add.listId: Field label for the numeric id of the list in Listmonk. Required — the asterisk is rendered separately. ≤4 words.
add.name: Field label for the name this CRM will show. Required — the asterisk is rendered separately. ≤2 words.
add.submit: Submit button of that form. Imperative, ≤3 words.
add.submitting: Label that button shows while the request is in flight. Ends with an ellipsis character. ≤2 words.
errors.load: Fallback in the error banner when the wired lists could not be fetched and the server gave no message. No trailing period.
errors.add: Fallback under the form when wiring up a list failed and the server gave no message. No trailing period.
errors.delete: Fallback in the delete toast when the server gave no message. No trailing period.
